nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential = the value your app sends as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. responseMode onReceived returns 200 immediately so the chat turn never waits.

nodes.name: AutoCRM Login
nodes.notes: AutoCRM is cookie-auth only for these routes. fullResponse:true is REQUIRED so we can read set-cookie. Login is CSRF-exempt (app/auth/cookies.py _CSRF_EXEMPT_PATHS). CHECKED: /api/leads/ingest does NOT accept X-AI-Service-Token -- it is Depends(require_auth), and the service token only works on /api/agent/*. So this node stays. See README s1.1 for why swapping the backend dependency is not the one-word fix it looks like.

nodes.name: Extract Cookies
nodes.notes: Access token TTL is 30 min (default). We log in per execution rather than caching, so TTL never matters.

nodes.name: Switch Event
nodes.notes: No high_value_lead output on purpose. Urgency is a branch INSIDE lead_created (see IF Hot Lead) so a hot lead never creates two CRM records.

nodes.name: Check Existing Sync
nodes.notes: Idempotency guard. The widget rehydrates on every WordPress page load, so the same session can emit lead_created more than once.

nodes.name: Upsert AutoCRM Lead
nodes.notes: VERIFIED against backend source (app/services/import_service.py:286). /api/leads/ingest, NOT /api/leads/ -- ingest_lead_payload() accepts full_name as an alias for name, UPSERTS by email, auto-creates the organization from company, and turns a `notes` key into a lead note. That is why this single call replaces the old Create Lead + Attach Note pair. Note insert dedupes on exact content, so a replayed webhook writes nothing. Do NOT send `score`: LeadCreate.score is int 0-100, not 'hot'/'warm'/'cold', and the backend recalculates it anyway. status must be one of new/contacted/nurture/qualified/unqualified/junk (app/utils/statuses.py). No trailing slash on this path.

nodes.name: Append to Sheets
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate matching on session_id, NOT plain append. The guard upstream only arms once Write Back runs at the END of the branch, so any failure after this node left the sheet with a row and agent_runs without a crm_lead_id -- and the next delivery appended a second row. Matching on session_id makes the sheet self-healing: one row per conversation no matter how many times the event is redelivered.

nodes.name: IF Hot Lead
nodes.notes: This is the old high_value_lead event, folded in. Score is computed deterministically in code (plan s8) - not by the model.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Hot Alert
nodes.notes: WhatsApp Cloud API only allows free-form text inside a 24h customer-service window. Outbound-initiated alerts to your own reps need an approved message TEMPLATE. See README s6.

={{ JSON.stringify({

  p_visitor_name: $('Webhook').item.json.body.fields.visitor_name,
  p_visitor_email: $('Webhook').item.json.body.fields.visitor_email,
  p_visitor_phone: $('Webhook').item.json.body.fields.visitor_phone,
  p_company_name: $('Webhook').item.json.body.fields.company_name,
  p_service_recommended: $('Webhook').item.json.body.fields.service_recommended,
  p_lead_status: $('Webhook').item.json.body.score,
  p_pages_visited: $('Webhook').item.json.body.pages_visited,
  p_transcript: ($('Webhook').item.json.body.transcript_text || '')
    .split('\n').filter(l => l.trim())
    .map(l => { const i = l.indexOf(':');

                   : { role: 'user', content: l.trim() }; }),
}) }}

nodes.name: Write Back (lead_created)
nodes.notes: Was a Postgres UPDATE. mark_run_outcome COALESCEs every optional arg, so omitted keys leave their column untouched.

nodes.name: Update Lead Status
nodes.notes: CORRECTED: lead status is NOT free text. app/routers/leads.py runs normalize_status() against LEAD_STATUSES = {new, contacted, nurture, qualified, unqualified, junk}; the old 'meeting_scheduled' returned 422. 'qualified' is the closest true state for a booked discovery call. STILL OPEN: AutoCRM's real qualification step is POST /api/leads/{id}/convert-to-deal, which also creates a deal -- but that needs a deal `value` a website chat cannot produce. Leaving it as a status update so a human sets the number after the call. See README s7.

nodes.name: Conversation Ended
nodes.notes: Expected traffic, not an error -- api/chat.py emits this on widget unload. Deliberately does nothing: api/store.py already writes ended_at and duration_ms straight to agent_runs over SQL. A branch here would be a second writer for the same two columns. It exists so the execution log says 'Conversation Ended' instead of 'Unknown Event'.
